alt

options.text: vh
rem
px
em

block for div, inline for span

display: flex

questionMappings.question: What is the CSS specificity hierarchy from highest to lowest priority?

Element -> Class -> ID -> Inline style
All selectors have identical specificity weight
Class -> ID -> Element -> Inline style

questionMappings.question: What does the CSS pseudo-class `:nth-child(2n+1)` match?

The second child only
Every child after the second
Even numbered children

questionMappings.question: How does `position: sticky` behave in CSS?

It acts as `relative` until a specified scroll threshold is reached, then sticks like `fixed` within its parent container
It animates smoothly to the center of the screen
It prevents the element from being clicked

questionMappings.question: What is the primary difference between CSS Grid and CSS Flexbox?

Grid only works with fixed pixel units

Whichever rule was written latest in the CSS file always wins
By the total character length of the selector string
